about: Labeled examples for lessons learned from this incident. 'incident' tests come from the incident's own code before the fix; 'team example' tests are the team's hand-labeled cases. Paths are relative to this folder. Verdicts only: a learned lesson may name its conditions differently.

tests.note: Relabeled Oct 20 from clear to flag: on TaskAgentSessionExpiredException it calls CreateSessionAsync, which retries on a fixed 30 s interval, so the method can enter the fixed-delay loop even though its own polling wait is random and growing. A revised draft lesson's judge caught this; the original label looked only at the method's own delay.
